At the bottom of the Darashia Dragon Lair, north of Darashia, there is a dead dragon with a {item:Life Ring} inside. Cross the lair's three hunting levels, facing {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, and collect the ring.
Darashia Dragon Lair entrance (north of Darashia)
Level 40 to pass the {wiki:Gate of Expertise} at the entrance (60+ recommended).
Potions and supplies to face Dragons and up to 7 Dragon Lords.
The Dragon Lords on the 2nd level show up one by one along the path: kill them separately instead of pulling them together.
Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (with your city's captain, say {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the port of {npc:Petros}) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).

Leave Darashia to the **north**, through the desert, to the entrance of the {wiki:Darashia Dragon Lair} ({coord:33264,32277,7}). Go in through the level 40 {wiki:Gate of Expertise} and go down to the first hunting level.

Here there are only {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}. Head **south** to the stairs that go down to the second level. On this path you meet 2 Dragons at most.
Here there are Dragons and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}. Head **northwest** to the stairs that lead to the third level. Along the way you face 1 to 3 Dragon Lords, one at a time.
Dragon Lords deal a lot of fire damage. Don't go on without full health and mana.
The third level has **4 Dragon Lords**. Look for the **dead dragon** and open the corpse: inside is the {item:Life Ring}.

The lair has no exit teleport: go back the same way. From the third level go up the stairs to the second (Dragon Lords), cross it to the stairs to the first and go up again to the entrance, north of Darashia. The Dragons and Dragon Lords you left behind may have respawned, so don't go up without full health and mana.
Once outside, head **south** through the desert to Darashia. From there you can take {npc:Petros}' boat or {npc:Chemar}'s flying carpet back to your city.
